Subject: Procurement: billing header alignment & PO ID schema for Lumen Health

Hi Olga / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Lumen's procurement team is ready to move forward with a pilot but we need to align on a few billing/PO requirements before we can issue a Purchase Order. High level asks from our side: 

- PO header: the PO MUST include a single globally-unique PO number in the header and a separate "ServiceLineRef" ID per invoice line (our ERP requires both).
- Invoice cadence: pilot invoices will be monthly, but billing needs to accept both consolidated monthly statements and single-line invoices for specific projects.
- Net terms: our standard is Net45, but Finance has asked if Redwood can accept Net30 for early-adopter pilots or provide a 2% net-10 early payment discount.
- Remit details: we need Redwood's remit-to address, VAT/Tax ID, and preferred remit email.
- PO attachment: please confirm you can accept PO PDF + embedded SOW in DocuSign, and map DocuSign IDs back to invoices.

I've attached our PO template (Lumen_PO_template.xlsx) for reference. Can you confirm fields Redwood requires on the invoice and whether Redwood can map our ServiceLineRef to your internal service codes?

Goal: confirm billing acceptance criteria by EOD Thursday so procurement can issue a pilot PO next week.

Thanks,
Sofia Morales
Sr. Sourcing Manager — Lumen Health

Sofia — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Vanessa from Sales Ops so we can confirm both commercial and finance-side constraints. Quick answers and next steps below: 

1) PO / ServiceLineRef mapping: Yes, we can ingest a single PO header (PO number) and preserve an arbitrary ServiceLineRef field per line as a custom invoice attribute. We will also include our internal "ServiceVendorID" tag on each invoice line to simplify reconciliation. Please ensure ServiceLineRef is exported as a text field in your template (not a formula).

2) Invoice cadence: We support both consolidated monthly statements and single-line invoices. For the pilot, monthly consolidated statements are fine; if you need single-line invoicing for specific projects, we can tag those lines and route them to a separate billing code.

3) Net terms / discount: We can accept Net45 standard. For pilots, Redwood can offer Net30 if Lumen signs a short addendum. Alternatively, Finance suggests a 2% discount for Net10 (early payment). I will confirm final finance approval and include options in the SOW.

4) Remit + tax: Attached is a short PDF listing the billing fields we require (Redwood-billing-fields.pdf). Please share your remit address and tax ID so we can add it to our invoicing system.

5) DocuSign / PO attachments: We can consume DocuSign as the canonical SOW and will map the DocuSign PowerForm ID back into our invoice metadata. If you plan to include the PO as a PDF attachment to the DocuSign envelope, please add the PO number as the envelope subject to ensure auto-mapping.

Next steps: Vanessa — can you confirm whether Sales Ops needs a commercial counter-signature on the addendum for Net30 pilots or if Finance's 2% Net10 is preferable? I will prepare a one-page addendum and attach it to the DocuSign.

Olga

Olga / Vanessa / Sofia — quick finance note from our side: 

- Net terms: Standard enterprise practice for Redwood is Net45. We can approve Net30 for pilots up to $50k/month with a monthly reconciliation cadence and a PO that includes the billing BU code. For anything above that we need a signed addendum.
- Early payment discount: We can do 2% if Lumen can commit to Net10 and provide an ACH remittance setup; this requires finance onboarding and a one-time vendor data form.
- Required invoice fields: PO number (header), ServiceLineRef (custom field), Redwood ServiceVendorID (we will populate; you do not need to provide), Billing entity name, Remit address, Tax ID, Contact email for remittance issues.
- Invoice format: PDF or EDI 810 both acceptable. If you plan to use EDI, please let us know so we can assign an EDI endpoint and test.

I attached our short billing checklist which matches Olga's note. If Lumen can confirm remit details and preferred net term option, I'll queue the vendor onboarding ticket.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
